title: Plant-Based Black Bean Taco Soup
description: This meatless, taco-flavored soup is loaded with black beans and gets its robust flavor from the combination of spices and fire-roasted tomatoes. You won't notice it's plant-based!
ingredients: 1 medium green bell pepper, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 medium red bell pepper, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 medium jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced
2 (15 ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (15 ounce) can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
0.5 teaspoon ground cumin, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon chili powder, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon smoked paprika, or to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion, bell peppers, celery, carrots, jalapeno peppers, and garlic; cook until veggies soften, 3 to 5 minutes.

Add diced tomatoes; stir well and cook for 3 minutes. Add vegetable broth, black and pinto beans, corn, cumin, chili powder, paprika, and salt; stir until well combined. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.
